facts.text: During the Israel Bible Extension (IBEX) program, students spend 15 weeks studying, exploring, and living in Israel.

sources.title: Israel Bible Extension Program | The Master's University
sources.quote: During the Israel Bible Extension (IBEX) program, students spend 15 weeks studying, exploring, and living in the Promised Land.

facts.text: The price for a semester in Israel is the same as that of a TMU student living on the California campus, plus the cost of airfare.

sources.title: Israel Bible Extension Program | The Master's University
sources.quote: The price for a semester in Israel (including tuition, full board and class-related travel expenses) is the same as that of a TMU student living on the California campus, plus the cost of airfare.
